roll.9:
18 May 2023: Sam and Evan caught up. Evan sold his old Prius and took family in new Prius to Rockies (11–17 May); shared lake/mountain photo. Sam shared sunset/forest photos, childhood hikes with dad, considered painting; Evan shared desert watercolor.

24 May: Evan described Jasper/Icefields Parkway. Sam worried about weight; Evan encouraged healthy eating/exercise.

6 Jun: Evan had palpitations, changed lifestyle, offered Sam exercise lessons (accepted). Sam disliked self-checkouts.

27 Jul: Friends mocked Sam’s weight; Sam planned gym, less soda/candy. Evan encouraged small steps; reading *The Great Gatsby*, called it a mystery.

7–15 Aug: Evan shared Canadian girlfriend, family, outdoor/vacation photos; health progress. His son hurt ankle playing soccer, wore cast. Sam shared health struggles, flying dream, began healthy-cooking class; shared salmon/vegetables.

19 Aug: Sam dieting, shared healthy meals/recipes; felt more energetic. Evan started watercolor classes, paints landscapes for peace, shared forest/ocean/tree paintings; enjoys road trips and winter sports, skied Banff in July. Sam wanted to ski but doubted physical ability.

27 Aug: Sam said new diet/exercise routine started 21 Aug, felt great. Evan had twisted knee 25 Aug; awaiting PT, swimming meanwhile. He shared Rocky Mountains road-trip photo from July. They discussed hiking; Evan invited Sam to hike at a lake with nearby trails, a two-hour drive. Sam planned a day trip.

rebuild.9:

Shared lake/book photo 2023-05-24, called it glacier photo. Watercolor fan for years; friend introduced him; painting relieves stress, brings peace/self-expression. Began watercolor classes shortly before 2023-08-19 to improve/meet people; paints landscapes, observing nature. Road trips: Banff skiing July 2023; Rocky Mountains July 2023. Likes skiing, snowboarding, skating, hiking. Met unnamed Canadian woman on 2023-07-31–08-06 trip; became significant other, later vacationed hiking/biking. Children motivate him; shared swing photo. Health journey ~2 years; heart palpitation week of 2023-05-29 prompted lifestyle changes; cuts processed/sugary foods, likes ginger snaps. Fitness watch motivates him; bonsai symbolizes resilience. Twisted knee 2023-08-25; swimming, considering PT. Son injured ankle playing soccer 2023-08-12; improving by Aug 15. Book “The Great Gatsby” mentioned July 27; later book title unknown.

Sam: special long hike with father age 10. No hobby by 2023-05-18; tried/considered painting for stress. Weight concern at checkup May; friends mocked weight July 21. Pursuing health, reducing soda/candy, diet/exercise; flavored seltzer liked, cooking class, salmon/veg Aug 14, spinach-avocado-strawberry bowl Aug 19, chicken stir-fry. Started routine Aug 21, felt great. Challenges, motivated by “Don't fear it, just take the first step”; values small wins, Evan’s support. Wants hiking/road trips; agreed to check out unnamed lake/trails 2 hours away (Aug 27). Dreamed of flying over skyscrapers night Aug 12.

Enjoys watercolor, hiking, skiing/snowboarding/skating, gym, road trips and nature; painting relieves stress and expresses feelings, especially landscapes. Started classes Aug 2023. Sam: pursued healthier eating/exercise after weight concerns, gastritis ER visit Oct 14–15, 2023, and friends’ hurtful remarks July 21. Tried cooking class, diet, seltzer; became Weight Watchers group coach Nov 9. Enjoys journaling/writing; learning drawing, considering painting.  
Sam and Evan are supportive friends; discussed painting, hiking, kayaking/Lake Tahoe, beach visit Dec 2023, daily gratitude. Evan offered fitness help; Sam values encouragement. Sam’s quote: “Don't fear it, just take the first step.”
